rules.name: Bold Gallantry
rules.effect: Each time an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army Advances, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** models from your army have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

rules.name: Assault
rules.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[ASSAULT]** weapon can shoot using **assault shooting** (10.05).

stratagems.name: Run Them Through!
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LANCE] to unit's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Thunderstomp
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.
stratagems.summary: Armoured Feet: 8 Attacks, +1 AP; Titanic Feet: 12 Attacks, +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Full Tilt
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of your models and add 2 to Advance rolls made for those model’s units.
stratagems.summary: +2" Move, +2 to Advance rolls.

stratagems.name: Vow of Retribution
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LETHAL HITS] to ranged weapons until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Tactical Foil
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 8" of that unit.
stratagems.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.summary: Move up to D6".

stratagems.name: Rotate Ion Shields
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.summary: Grant 4+ invulnerable save to unit.

rules.name: Sacristan Pledge
rules.effect: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model within 3" of this model that has not been selected by this ability this phase. If you do, that model **heals** D3 wounds.

rules.name: Assisted Targeting (Aura)
rules.effect:
While a friendly **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit is within 6" of this model, that **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit’s ranged attacks have:
- +1 **BS**.
- **[HEAVY]**

rules.name: Cogbound Alliance
rules.effect:
Friendly **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** models have the **Assisted Targeting (Aura)** ability.

Friendly **TECH-PRIEST** models have the **Sacristan Pledge** ability:

rules.name: Mechanicus Allies
rules.effect: You can include **TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS/TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS/MARSHAL/RANGERS/VANGUARD** units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

stratagems.name: Omnissiah’s Grace
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Vengeance of the Machine Cult
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: One friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle: While a unit is marked, friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units’ attacks that target that unit can re-roll wound rolls.
stratagems.summary: Mark enemy unit; friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units re-roll wounds against marked units.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Giants
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
stratagems.summary: Unit can move and still start an action.

enhancements.name: Magos Questoris
enhancements.effect: **TECH-PRIEST** model only. When using this model’s **Sacristan Pledge** ability, the selected **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model **heals** 2 additional wounds.

enhancements.name: Knight of the Opus Machina (Aura)
enhancements.effect: **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model only. While a friendly **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit is within 6" of this model, that **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit’s melee attacks have +1 **WS** and **AP**.

rules.name: Against the Horde
rules.effect: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll, and weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Dauntless Defenders
rules.effect:
At the start of the first battle round, select two objectives to be your foundations. Place a circular 40mm foundation marker in each one. When you draw a line from any part of one your foundation markers to any part of the other, if any part of a model’s base (or any part of a model’s hull, for a model without a base) crosses that line, that model’s unit is said to be on your defensive line.

While an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army is on your defensive line, that unit has the Against the Horde ability.

rules.name: Sustained Hits
rules.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

stratagems.name: Drive Them Out!
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit on your defensive line, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.summary: [LETHAL HITS] on attacks vs enemies on your defensive line (5+).

stratagems.name: Lancebreaker
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greaterthan the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll
stratagems.summary: Subtract 1 from Wound rolls if attack Strength > unit Toughness.

stratagems.name: Steadfast Superiority
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that is on your defensive line and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls for unit's attacks until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Marshal the Defence
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: Up to two IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units from your army that have not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your units.
stratagems.summary: Add 3" to Move characteristic until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Titanic Bombardment
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that Remained Stationary this turn, that is on your defensive line and that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 2] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Fortress of Intimidation
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units charging you take Battle-shock test at -1.

rules.name: Heroes of Legend
rules.effect:
At the start of your turn, if your current Oath is fulfilled, determine an additional Oath, with the exception that you cannot select a Deed or Quality you have already selected (if you are randomly selecting the Deed and/or Quality and roll any result that you have already selected, select a Deed or Quality you have not already selected instead). If you cannot determine an additional Oath because you have already selected each Deed and each Quality, do not determine an additional Oath.

The Qualities from Oaths you have fulfilled continue to apply to all models in your army with the Code Chivalric ability. When the Deed for an additional Oath is completed, you instead gain 1CP, regardless of how you selected the Deed or Quality.

rules.name: Valour's Reward
rules.effect: The Enhancements for this detachment can become expended. You cannot use such Enhancements while they are expended. Each time you fulfil your Oath, each expended Enhancement is no longer expended.

stratagems.name: Courageous Stand
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant Feel No Pain 6+ to unit.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Hit and Wound rolls against MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER units.

stratagems.name: Moment of Glory
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.summary: Consolidate +3" if can end within Engagement Range of enemy.

stratagems.name: Hero’s Tread
stratagems.timing: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.summary: Control objective at Level 5 until opponent exceeds it.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Warrior
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Fell Back unit can shoot and declare charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Driven by the Past
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to charge after Advancing.

rules.name: Knightly Teachings
rules.effect: Each time a model from your army uses its Bondsman ability, if no other model from your army has used that Bondsman ability that turn, you can select up to three friendly **^^Armiger^^** models (instead of one) within 12" of that model, or within 15" of that model while your army is Honoured (you still cannot select a model that is already being affected by a Bondsman ability). Until the start of your next Command phase, those models are affected by that Bondsman ability.

rules.name: Keywords
rules.effect: **^^Armiger^^** models from your army gain the **^^Battleline^^** keyword.

stratagems.name: Virtue of Courage
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Hit for ARMIGER attacks targeting selected enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Exemplar’s Wisdom
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, just after an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army has shot.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: ARMIGER attacks vs selected enemy unit gain +1 AP until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Mantle of the Mentor
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: ARMIGER models can shoot after Fall Back.

stratagems.name: Thin Their Ranks
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [RAPID FIRE 1] to ARMIGER ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Let Duty Be Your Shield
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ARMIGER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Squires Ofthe Hunt
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Remove ARMIGER models within 9" of battlefield edges (not in Engagement Range) to Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Knights of Legend
rules.effect: **^^Imperial Knights^^** models from your army have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. In addition, at the start of your Command phase, each **^^Imperial Knights^^** model from your army regains 1 lost wound.

rules.name: Feel No Pain
rules.effect: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

stratagems.name: Noble Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an ARMIGER unit, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.summary: Deadly Demise triggers on 4+ (5+ for non-ARMIGER); +1 to roll if ARMIGER.

stratagems.name: Strength From Exile
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 9" of your unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 if no other friendly units within 9".

stratagems.name: Full Tilt
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 9" instead if your unit is an ARMIGER or DESTRIER unit.
stratagems.summary: Advance without roll; +6" Move (+9" if ARMIGER/DESTRIER).

stratagems.name: Point‑blank Barrage
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making ranged attacks with Blast weapons, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of your unit (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, until the end of the phase, your unit does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, but each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Blast weapon that targets a unit within Engagement Range of your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
stratagems.summary: Blast weapons can target enemies in Engagement Range; no Hit penalty for being in Engagement Range; unmodified 1s on Blast attacks vs. Engagement Range targets inflict 1 mortal wound on your unit.

stratagems.name: Survivor of Strife
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Wound rolls when S > T.

stratagems.name: Flanking Manoeuvres
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ARMIGER unit from your army that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Remove unit from battlefield; place into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Rain of Devastation
rules.effect: Friendly **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS** units’ attacks that target a unit in a **terrain area** have +1 to **hit rolls**.

stratagems.name: Ground-shaking Strides
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit is selected to move.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2" M.
stratagems.summary: +2" Movement.

stratagems.name: Foebreaker Firestorm
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s [BLAST] ranged attacks: Do not have [BLAST]. Have +1 A.
stratagems.summary: Your unit's [BLAST] ranged attacks lose [BLAST], gain +1 A.

stratagems.name: Fire Shocked
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
stratagems.summary: Enemy unit hit makes battle-shock roll at -1.

rules.name: Driven From Their Lairs
rules.effect:
While a friendly **ARMIGER** unit is affected by a **Bondsman** ability, that unit’s ranged attacks have **[IGNORES COVER]**.

This **detachment** has the **ARMIGERS** tag and cannot be taken with another **ARMIGERS detachment**.

stratagems.name: Neural Lash
stratagems.timing: Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly battle-shocked ARMIGER unit within 12" of your unit. That ARMIGER unit is no longer battle-shocked.
stratagems.summary: Remove Battle-shocked from friendly ARMIGER within 12".

stratagems.name: Helm Conditioning
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit uses a Bondsman ability.
stratagems.cond: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: When selecting an ARMIGER model for that Bondsman ability, you can select one within 18" of your unit (excluding models already affected by a Bondsman ability).
stratagems.summary: Select ARMIGER within 18" for Bondsman ability (instead of closer range).

stratagems.name: Honoured to Serve
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ARMIGER unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: That ARMIGER unit.
stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
stratagems.summary: Attacks don't prevent starting an action.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D6
abilities.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6"). 
***Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Then the Intercessors make an **emergency disembark move**. Then the roll is made for the **Deadly Demise** ability, and on a 6, that ability is resolved. Finally, the Impulsor is removed from the battlefield.*

abilities.name: Super-Heavy Walker
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit with this ability makes a **normal**, **advance** or **fall-back move**: 
- Models in that unit can move through models (including **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models, but excluding **TITANIC** models) and can move horizontally through sections of **terrain features** that are 4" or less in height. 
- Before moving that unit, you can select for all models in that unit to have the **MOBILE** keyword until that move ends. If you do, when that move ends, roll one D6: on a 1, that unit is battle-shocked. 
***Designer’s Note:** Gaining the **MOBILE** keyword for the duration of a move will enable models in that unit to move horizontally through **dense terrain features** (13.06).*

abilities.name: Code Chivalric
abilities.effect:
If your Army Faction is **^^Imperial Knights^^**, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army's Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part.

To determine your army's Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army's Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

abilities.name: Thundercharge
abilities.effect: If this model is equipped with a thundershock spear and a bellatus reaper chainsword, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

abilities.name: Ram Jets
abilities.effect: Each time this unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, until the end of the phase, add D3" to the Move characteristic of this model.

abilities.name: Saturation Fire
abilities.effect: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within range of one or more objective markers, that attack has the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save (5+*)
abilities.effect: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

damaged.name: Damaged: 1-6 Wounds Remaining
damaged.effect: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, subtract 4 from this model's Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.effect:

On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6"). 
***Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Then the Intercessors make an **emergency disembark move**. Then the roll is made for the **Deadly Demise** ability, and on a 6, that ability is resolved. Finally, the Impulsor is removed from the battlefield.*

glossary.name: Assault
glossary.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[ASSAULT]** weapon can shoot using **assault shooting** (10.05).

glossary.name: Rapid Fire
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[RAPID FIRE X]**. Each time you gather **attack dice** for a **[RAPID FIRE]** weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. 
***Example:** If a **[RAPID FIRE 1]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Lance
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[LANCE]** weapon, if the attacking model’s unit made a **charge move** this turn, add 1 to the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Blast
glossary.effect:
Each time you gather attack dice for a **[BLAST]** weapon, add one additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form **[BLAST X]**, each time you gather **attack dice** for such a weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. 
***Example:** If a **[BLAST 2]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Sustained Hits
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

glossary.name: Lone Operative
glossary.effect:
Unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form **Lone Operative X"**, unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within **X"** of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within **X"** of this unit.

glossary.name: Melta
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[MELTA X]**. Each time a model makes an attack with a **[MELTA]** weapon, if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step, until the attacking unit’s attacks have been resolved, add **X** to that weapon’s **D** characteristic. 
***Example:** A model targets a unit that is within half range of a **[MELTA 2]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of D6. While resolving those attacks, that weapon has a **D** characteristic of **D6+2**.*

glossary.name: Anti
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[ANTI-X Y+]**. Each time an attack is made with an **[ANTI]** weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by **X**, an unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** is a **critical wound**.
***Example:** An attack made with an **[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]** weapon against a ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 4+, while an attack made with an **[ANTI-PSYKER 2+]** weapon against a ^^**Psyker**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 2+.*

glossary.name: Twin-linked
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TWIN-LINKED]** weapon, you can re-roll the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Indirect Fire
glossary.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapon can shoot using indirect shooting (10.07).

glossary.name: Lethal Hits
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[LETHAL HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
***Designer’s Note:** Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no **wound roll** is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a **critical wound** and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

glossary.name: Devastating Wounds
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon results in a **critical wound**, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of **mortal wounds** equal to the **D** characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
**Mortal wounds** inflicted by **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each **critical wound**; any remaining **mortal wounds** inflicted by that attack are lost. 
***Example:** An attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of 3 results in a **critical wound** against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 **mortal wounds**. The first 2 **mortal wounds** are sufficient to **destroy** 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining **mortal wound** is lost.*

glossary.name: Torrent
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TORRENT]** weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

glossary.name: Ignores Cover
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with an **[IGNORES COVER]** weapon, the target cannot have the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08), including from rules that give a model or unit the **benefit of cover** (e.g. **Stealth**).

glossary.name: Hazardous
glossary.effect: Each time a unit is **selected to shoot** or **selected to fight**, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of **hazard rolls** (06.03) for that unit equal to the number of **[HAZARDOUS]** weapons you selected in the Select Weapons step.

glossary.name: Heavy
glossary.effect:
In your Shooting phase, each time an attack is made with a **[HEAVY]** weapon, add 1 to the **hit roll** if all of the following apply to the attacking unit: 
- That unit is **unengaged**. 
- That unit was not set up on the battlefield this turn. 
- No model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.
